Echo execute accepts only immutable EntryPoint and sets/checks cache.entered before every external call; nested router entry is rejected. Before/after balance deltas are intentional actual-spend accounting, followed by limits and atomic registry.recordSpend. Trusted approved non-rebasing token semantics remain an assumption. See EchoDelegationModule.sol:149-183 and test_reentrantRouterCannotEnterAccount.

TraceRuleProbe intentionally exercises forbidden validation behavior; its payable sink is not a funded production wallet or withdrawal interface.

The standalone delegation implementation has a payable receiver and no withdrawal function: funds sent to that implementation itself are not recoverable through this ABI. The intended account is a delegated EOA; its owner retains native transaction authority. Do not treat the implementation address as the funded account. No native-ETH recovery experiment is claimed in this scan.

Validation intentionally drops inner bytes after canonical decoder checks; complete calldata is covered by userOpHash, while target/auth/swap constraints are checked. Execution decodes the same canonical bytes.
ECDSA.tryRecover error argument is diagnostic only; the error enum must be NoError and recovered signer must match. Dropping the diagnostic field does not accept an invalid signature.
